en:
Alright, let's go to Miu's lab.
I saw it in the courtyard...

Oh, you mean the large building in the
garden at the bottom of the stairs...

Hm... Up until now, our research labs have
just been normal classrooms...
Well...that seems alright, doesn't it?
Ah, good morning.

Morning.
What are you doing?

It's nothing all that important.
I'm just checking something.
Checking something?

The ancient passport in the hallway and that 
object in the courtyard...

It just plain stands out.
It makes you curious, right?

Actually...I was a little
curious about that too.

I never feel satisfied until I've mapped
out every tile in a dungeon.

It bothers me when there's blank squares on the
map, so I walk into every trap at least once.
Ah...what are you talking about?
Oh, sorry. I was talking about games.
You walk into traps on purpose?

It's just the nature of mappers. 
Rather, it's more of a curse.
O-Oh...

That's why I can't leave stuff like this alone.
It'd make me feel just plain awful.

Umm, I wonder what this thing's 
even for...

The ancient passport in this hallway and that
object in the courtyard... What are they for?

Um, Kaede? That's the boys bathroom...
Do you have...a reason to be in there?

O-Ooh, sorry!
My mistake!
Ah, you want me to...wait for you?

N-No, it's okay!
Sorry, let's get going!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
